rules.bank_location: A banked item remains owned by its character and is located at one explicit bank identity.
rules.merchant_location: Merchant stock is represented by item instances owned by and located at one merchant identity.
rules.deposit: Only carried and unequipped items may be deposited; no_bank rejects atomically.
rules.withdraw: Only an item owned by the character and stored in the requested bank may be withdrawn.
rules.sell: Only carried and unequipped items may enter merchant stock; no_sell, binding, and quest ownership restrictions apply.
rules.buy: Only an item in the requested merchant stock may transfer to the buyer; binding and quest ownership restrictions apply.
rules.economy_boundary: Items mutates item identity and ownership only; Economy owns price calculation and currency transfer.

fallback: Unknown Classic bank or merchant rules remain inactive; malformed projected metadata fails validation.
native_dependencies: Classic no-bank and no-sell flag bits
